title: RFC 9700: Best Current Practice for OAuth 2.0 Security
author: IETF OAuth Working Group
why: The current rules for OAuth: PKCE everywhere, no implicit or password grants, refresh token rotation or sender-constraining.

title: RFC 8725: JSON Web Token Best Current Practices
author: Sheffer, Hardt and Jones
why: A short, readable list of how JWT verification goes wrong (alg none, algorithm confusion, missing audience checks) and how to avoid it.

title: OpenID Connect Core 1.0
author: OpenID Foundation
why: The primary source for ID token claims and the validation steps a client must perform.

title: OWASP Session Management Cheat Sheet
author: OWASP
why: Concrete guidance on session ID entropy, cookie flags, expiry and logout for server-side sessions.
